propositions: rebar must not use git stash operations in the tickets worktree because the stash stack is repo-global and shared across all worktrees, allowing stashes created in one worktree to be popped into another
the current stash-merge-pop dance in push.py can pollute the ticket store with source files and leave the index in an unmerged stranded state that blocks all store writes
the regenerable-files assumption in _resolve_conflicted_pop does not hold for foreign paths (source files, configuration) that should never be tracked on the tickets branch
a supported maintenance entrypoint with backup-before-write, refusal on unpushed commits, and durable audit logging must replace ad-hoc raw git operations by operators
foreign-path auto-heal in event_append._recover_from_unmerged must classify and discard unmerged paths not tracked on tickets branch to prevent store wedging
fsck must report any tracked-source paths polluting the tracker so corruption is detected rather than silently healed
